sentences.text: Tottenham Hotspur Football Club -LSB- ˈtɒtnəm , _ - tənəm -RSB- , commonly referred to as Spurs , is an English football club located in Tottenham , Haringey , London , that competes in the Premier League .	football	association football	Tottenham	Tottenham	Haringey	London Borough of Haringey	London	London	Premier League	Premier League
